exercises.q: Good leather will wear for years.
exercises.why: **носиться** — носи́ться (imperfective): to rush, to rush around, to run/drive around (on a high speed); to float around, to fly around; (colloquial) to fuss over, to pay too much attention to, to be obsessed with (an idea); (of smells, sounds, etc.) to spread. Wiktionary: носи́ть + -ся.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to take away, to take off, to carry (away)
to rush, to rush around, to run/drive around (on a high speed)
to carry out, to take out, to bring out, to remove
to transfer, to carry, to transport (somewhere)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: унести́ — to take away, to take off, to carry (away); носи́ться — to rush, to rush around, to run/drive around (on a high speed); выноси́ть — to carry out, to take out, to bring out, to remove; переноси́ть — to transfer, to carry, to transport (somewhere).
**выношу** — выноси́ть (imperfective): to carry out, to take out, to bring out, to remove; to transfer; to get, to acquire; to submit. Wiktionary: вы- + носи́ть.
